srcDirName.description: The name of the source directory.

libDirName.description: The name of the library directory under [srcDirName].

distDirName.description: The name of the dist directory at the root of the project.

buildConfigFileName.description: The name of the build configuration file optionally located in each component directory that is used for specifying build options.

customElementsManifestConfig.description: The name of the build configuration file optionally located in each component directory that is used for specifying build options.

configFileName.description: Optional config file to provide to the analyzer to customize generation of the custom elements manifest.

disableAutoGeneration.description: Disables automatic generation of the custom elements manifest as part of the build.

outputPath.description: The path to output the custom elements manifest to. This is relative to the project root.

copyFiles.description: Additional files to include in the built package.

pattern.description: A file name or glob pattern of files to include.

root.description: The directory relative to project root in which to apply the pattern.

output.description: The target path to copy the file to, relative to the release root directory.

license.description: Information about the license that this project uses for distribution.

header.description: The license header to prepend to built distribution files.

static.description: Configuration related to building the library into a static directory (typically for static assets usage or deployment)

enabled.description: Whether to enable static build or not.

includeWithPackage.description: Whether to include the static build output in the npm package or not.

codeSplitting.description: Whether to enable code splitting or not on the static ESM build output.

distPath.description: The path within the `distDir` to generate static build assets to.

distributionBundleName.description: The name of the distribution bundle to generate.

tsconfigPath.description: Sets the path to the tsconfig file to use.

esbuild.description: Additional options to provide to esbuild during compilation.

oneOf.description: The target environment to compile to.
The target environment to compile to.

supported.description: The externals definition for external modules.

additionalProperties.description: List of JavaScript syntax features to include in the compilation.

minify.description: Whether to minify the output or not.

bundle.description: Whether to bundle external dependencies in the output or not.

sassOptions.description: Options to provide to the sass compiler. See the Sass docs for more information.

paths.description: The project item path configuration. This allows for overriding the default location of files and directories within the project.

root.description: The root location of the project. All paths are relative to this location.

distDir.description: The path to the distribution directory that holds all build output.

distBuildDir.description: The path to the build directory.

distStylesDir.description: The path to the stylesheet build output directory.

distReleaseDir.description: The path to the npm package output directory.

distMetadataDir.description: The path to output metadata files.

srcDir.description: The path to the source directory.

libDir.description: The path to the component library directory.
